en.SY300 是 S300 系列场地版，采用 YBS300 四冲程发动机、冲压成型: The SY300 is the track-focused model in the S300 Series. It combines a YBS300 four-stroke engine, a stamped frame, reinforced suspension and a practical chain-adjustment structure for dependable obstacle clearance and approachable handling.
en.YBS300 四冲程动力，兼顾低转牵引与场地加速。: YBS300 four-stroke power balances low-speed traction with track acceleration.
en.冲压成型主体结构，兼顾车身刚性与灵活操控。: The stamped main structure balances frame rigidity with agile handling.
en.倒置式前叉配合后减震，应对连续起伏与复杂路况。: The inverted front fork and rear shock handle repeated undulations and complex terrain.
en.前后碟刹布局，提供清晰制动反馈与可靠控制。: Front and rear disc brakes provide clear feedback and dependable control.
en.单缸四冲程结构兼顾低转牵引与场地加速。: The single-cylinder four-stroke design balances low-speed traction with track acceleration.
en.提升前端刚性与连续冲击支撑，具体阻尼设定以订单配置为准。: Improves front-end rigidity and repeated-impact support; exact damping settings depend on the ordered configuration.
en.集成式灯组兼顾夜间辨识与紧凑车头造型，标配状态以订单为准。: The integrated lamp improves night-time visibility while retaining a compact front profile; standard fitment depends on the order.
en.宽齿面增强抓靴稳定性，并兼顾排泥空间与轻量化。: The wide toothed surface improves boot grip while preserving mud clearance and low weight.
en.标配无灯，可选装灯具: No lights as standard; lighting can be added as an option
